about.title: About JIACHENG NETTING
about.subtitle: Your Trusted HDPE Netting Partner Since 2005
about.description: SHANDONG JIACHENG CHEMICAL FIBER PRODUCTS CO., LTD is a professional manufacturer engaged in the production, research, development and sales of high-performance warp knitting plastic nets. Located in Zhanjia Industrial Park, Shanghe County, Jinan City, Shandong Province, China, our factory covers an area of approximately 20,000 square meters and is equipped with modern production equipment and a top-notch technical team.

products.name: Debris Netting
products.description: High density knitted polyethylene mesh netting (100% virgin HDPE). 1/4" mesh hole opening. Fire-Retardant: Meets NFPA 701 Method II. Edges & reinforced for easy installation. Will not unravel when cut. Stays flexible in cold weather. Any color available.
applications: Safety fence, barrier net, snow fence

products.name: Scaffolding Net / Debris Netting
products.description: High density knitted polyethylene mesh netting (100% virgin HDPE). 1/8", 7/16" mesh hole opening. Fire-Retardant: Meets NFPA 701 Method II. Reinforced eyelet holes for fastening. Will not unravel when cut. Stays flexible in cold weather.
applications: Contains debris, dust and job site materials

products.name: Mesh Tarp
products.description: 1/16" mesh hole openings, made of 100% virgin HDPE. Brass grommets spaced apart every 2" on all edges. Double-stitched sides and all hems are re-enforced with polyester webbing. UV treated & protected. Fire-Retardant: Meets NFPA 701 Method 2.
applications: Privacy screen, visual barrier, wind barrier

products.name: Tape Shade Net
products.description: Made of 100% virgin HDPE. 30%-95% shade rate. Water-proof. UV-treated. Width: 1m-12m (any length available). Color: Customize any color.
applications: Window, carport, porch and privacy screen

products.name: Shade Sail
products.description: Made of 100% virgin HDPE. Treated with a UV-stabilizing compound to prevent shade sails from drying out, tearing, and fading. All edges constructed with heavy-duty double-layered reinforced stitched seams. Each corner ends with a durable D-ring. Blocks 95% of harmful UV.

products.name: Anti Hail Net / Drape Net
products.description: 100% Virgin High Density Polyethylene (HDPE). Width: Maximum 12m. Length: Available in any length. Weight (GSM): 45g, 50g, 55g, 60g, 65g, 70g or as your request. UV treated & protected.
applications: Comprehensive protection against hail for crops

products.name: Privacy Net
products.description: Made of 100% Virgin High Density Polyethylene (HDPE). Width: Maximum 12m. Length: Any length available. 90% Visibility Blockage. Edges finished with heavy duty bindings and stainless copper grommets. All stitching reinforced.
specs: Heavy duty bindings, stainless copper grommets
applications: Protect personal privacy from prying eyes
Block surrounding noise and street view
Stops dogs from barking at neighbors

products.name: Olive Net / Harvest Net
products.description: Made of 100% Virgin High Density Polyethylene (HDPE). Width: Maximum 12m. Length: Any length available. UV Treated. Any color available. Can also be used to collect many fruits such as walnuts, hazelnuts, chestnuts and plums.
specs: Mesh type, GSM and color: Customizable

products.name: Anti-Bee Net
products.description: Made of 100% Virgin High Density Polyethylene (HDPE). Width: Maximum 12m. Length: Any length available. UV-stabilized. Weather, water, and acid resistant. Allows light, moisture, and spraying to reach the plants.
applications: Impedes bees and predators such as wasps

products.name: Anti-Bird Net
products.description: Made of 100% Virgin High Density Polyethylene (HDPE). Width: Maximum 12m. Length: Any length available. UV-stabilized. Weather, water, and acid resistant. Allows light, moisture, and spraying to reach the plants.

products.name: Weed Barrier Fabric
products.description: Made of Heavy-Duty Professional Grade Polypropylene Material, chemical free, durable, sturdy and corrosion resistant. Needle-punched to transmit water and air, preserving soil moisture. Fabric allows air and water through, superior permeability. Just water cleaning to be reusable.
